name: CBG plan_rejected → coordinator ask_user (plan needs the user)
description:
ADR-044 §addendum Slice 6 — plan-review escalate path (plan-phase analog of rule 07b). Fires when CBG (plan-review mode) decides plan_rejected: the plan can't faithfully capture the ask without user input (ambiguous/contradictory request, or a gap no re-plan can close). Spawns a coordinator scoped to ask_user. This is the plan-gate's fail-safe default — the user picks the next move (clarify, re-scope, abandon).

Fires only on plan_rejected (distinct from the chain-end rejected token, rule 07b), so the two gates' escalate paths never collide.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
The dev-via-test plan-review gate rejected the plan — and judged it NOT re-plannable (the user's ask needs clarification before any faithful plan is possible). CBG (reviewer-dev-via-test) at loop $entity.instance has the details.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read CBG's plan_rejected verdict. CBG's reason explains what the user must clarify.

Iteration 2 — call decide(action="ask_user", reason="<surface CBG's concern to the user as a plain-English question; ask them to clarify or re-scope>"). One question, addressed to the user, no internal jargon. The user replies and a fresh coordinator loop fires on their answer.

metadata.vs_07b: Plan-phase analog of the chain-end rejected→ask_user (07b). Distinct plan_rejected token keeps it disjoint from the work gate.
metadata.no_auto_recover: plan_rejected (vs plan_rejected_retry) is the human-needed verdict: no auto re-plan. The user clarifies and re-asks (a fresh chain).
